title: Kageki Duels
tagline: PvP On-Chain game to train and battle with other people party
description:
This is a game which incentivizes players to get new characters. Once characters are there, fight with characters in duels and make you characters experience to get the luck factor increased. Have different skills to manage in different terrains for figting battles with other people's card party. And best of all always have fun while playing. 
Contracts: https://github.com/prix0007/kageki_duels
how_its_made: This project uses a bunch of tech, including react, starknet-react and starknetjs and dojojs in UI. In onchain part it uses cairo contracts and pragma randomness sources to fetch randomness on chain and make it easier to decide on battle mechanics on the game.  It also have a utility backend to get and serve randomness on behalf of it's users for ease of end user onboarding via dynamic.
